data.one_liner: Bluetooth plugin for printing text, images, QR codes and barcodes to thermal printers on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: The package scans for BLE devices, connects to a selected printer, and sends ESC/POS commands to print receipts or labels. It supports printing plain text, images, QR codes and barcodes via a simple API.
use_when: You need to print receipts or labels from a Flutter app using a Bluetooth thermal printer.
Cross‑platform (iOS/Android) support is required without writing native code.
avoid_when: You target web, desktop, or platforms without Bluetooth support.
You need advanced layout control like arbitrary x,y positioning not yet implemented.
strengths: Works on both Android and iOS out of the box
Provides a stream of connection state for reactive UI
Supports text, image, QR code and barcode printing
weaknesses: Limited to thermal printers; no support for arbitrary positioning yet
Requires manual permission configuration on each platform
data.setup_notes: Add BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH_ADMIN and location permissions in AndroidManifest.xml; add NSBluetooth* and NSLocation* keys in iOS Info.plist.
